statement: let bump := fun (a b t : ℝ) => if a < t ∧ t < b then Real.exp (-1/((t-a)*(b-t))) else 0; let W := bump 1 (51/50); let b := bump (-1/40) (1/40); let K := fun (v : ℝ) => ∫ u : ℝ, b u * b (v-u); let d := fun (h : ℝ) => (∫ u : ℝ, (W u)^2/u)/16 * (∫ v : ℝ, K v*(1/(h+v+1/5)+1/(h+v-1/5)-2/(h+v))); ∀ h : ℝ, 1 ≤ h → 0 < d h

plain_statement.en: New route · Zero pairs and phases · TP-0019 · Prove positivity of the diagonal integral at both test frequencies

brief.zh: K 的小支撑上用二阶差正性，在 0 附近找有正测度的严格正集。
brief.en: Use curvature on the support of K and a set of positive measure near zero.
